parsed.rationale: Both participating records — `Breakpoint.stub` in `PlaylistStubs.swift` and `Playcut.stub` in `_Plant_PlaycutStub.swift` — carry `is_test: true` and reside in the `PlaylistTesting` source group of the `Playlist` package. These are test-fixture stub factory methods for distinct domain types (`Breakpoint` and `Playcut`); their structural similarity (Jaccard 0.71) reflects a common stub-factory pattern intentionally applied to separate model types rather than accidental duplication. Collapsing them into a single generic function would couple unrelated test-support types and obscure the intent of each stub.
